name: Miso Butter Pasta with Deli Turkey, Roast Squash, Mushrooms & Walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Divide butternut squash and mushrooms between two large baking sheet pans. Season with salt and pepper, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cups frozen butternut squash, pieces
3 (227 g) pkgs sliced white mushrooms
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice butter; sprinkle half over the veggies. (Place remaining butter in a small bowl and set aside.)
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve ¾-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
While the pasta is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the remaining butter along with miso paste, additional salt, and pepper. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp miso paste, red
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the miso butter and set aside.
Stack turkey slices one on top of another, then medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 680 g oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain and return to the pot. Add roasted veggies, walnuts, miso butter, turkey, reserved pasta water, and Parmesan, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
